task_description: Seed/replace the stored consent page template TEXT for both loan consent types (loaner_consent, guarantor_consent) with the user's exact new bilingual (Hindi+English) content via an idempotent DB migration on the chhath-templates D1 db, add the 4 missing placeholder tokens (LOAN_CONSENT_DATETIME, LOAN_STATUS, CONSENT_DATETIME, CONSENT_STATUS) the new text references wired to real loan_consents data, and verify the public Svelte consent preview page renders the new text while keeping the existing Accept / declaration-tick / Decline flow intact (no second UI).

verification.summary: Full backend suite 1114 pass / 0 fail (baseline 1097 + 3 placeholder tests + 14 migration tests, incl. 2 post-review byte-exact fixture assertions). Guard tests (migration-matrix, migration-target-databases, pr35-migration-ledger, h10-m38) green; ledger kind counts intact (inert 6, multi-db 2). frontend-svelte build succeeds with no consent-page code change. Independently verified the seeded loaner_consent/guarantor_consent text round-trips byte-for-byte identical to the user's provided fixtures (len 8832, exact), the stray backtick is preserved, apostrophes escaped correctly, and the migration is idempotent + self-healing. Test quality: FEAT-002 tests are prove-first (fail if a token is removed, confirmed by the coder); FEAT-003 tests assert real seeded rows, idempotency on re-apply, and a token-drift guard tying seeded tokens to the keys the code emits. No Dockerfile involved in this change; docker build not applicable.
